pro.title: Pro matches
pro.subtitle: The engine that reads a coach's taps, reading every match of the 2018 World Cup and Euro 2016 from open event data. It is here to show what the engine can do; a coach's own matches are read the same way.

list.empty: No team by that name here
list.emptyBody: Try another spelling, or the other tournament.

error.title: The match list did not load
error.body: Check the connection and try again.

evidenceLink.label: Professional matches
evidenceLink.title: Pro matches, read by the same engine
evidenceLink.body: Every match of the 2018 World Cup and Euro 2016: chance quality, who was on top, passing and the goals, from open event data.

live.label: Watch as live
live.speed: Speed: {{speed}} times real time. Change speed

notFound.body: There is no match with that number in the World Cup 2018 or Euro 2016 data.

error.title: The match did not load

numbers.title: Match in numbers
numbers.caption: {{home}} and {{away}} compared
numbers.note: Share of passes is each team's part of all passes, not time on the ball: the data has events, not possession time.

race.title: Chance quality, as it piled up
race.intro: Each step is a shot, as big as the chance it was. Dots are goals.
race.label: Chance quality over the match up to minute {{minute}}: {{home}} {{homeValue}}, {{away}} {{awayValue}}.

top.title: Who was on top
top.intro: The same reading a coach gets after a match, from shots, corners, entries into the box and the ball won or lost, with the same honesty strip.

shots.title: Where the chances came from
shots.intro: Both teams attack the goal at the top. A penalty is drawn on the spot.
shots.note: Chance quality is our model's estimate, trained on men's professional shots like these. It ranks chances; it does not say what any one shot deserved.

players.title: Players
players.intro: Key passes, duels and interceptions are the data provider's own tags.
players.caption: {{team}} players
players.compact: {{passes}} passes · {{accuracy}} · {{shots}} shots · {{chance}} chance quality · duels {{duels}} · {{interceptions}} interceptions

source.title: Source and limits
source.changes: Klupa reduced the events to a compact form and computed every number on this page itself.
source.limitPositions: Event data records where the ball was played, not where every player stood, so nothing here can show off-the-ball positions or pressing shape.
source.limitModel: Chance quality comes from a model fitted to professional shots; it estimates how good a chance was, not how good the finish was.

network.title: Passing network
network.intro: Starters at the average spot of their passes, sized by how many they made; lines by how often the ball went between two players. Tap a player to see only theirs.
network.label: {{team}} passing network: {{players}} starters on a pitch, attacking left to right.
network.player: {{name}}, {{passes}} passes. Show only this player’s links
network.note: The data names no receiver: a pass is read as received by the next player of the same team to touch the ball within ten seconds.
network.table: Pairs with three or more passes, as a table
network.caption: {{team}}: passes between pairs of players

territory.title: Territory
territory.intro: Every touch with a position, on one pitch. A cell takes the colour of the team with more touches there, stronger the more it had.
territory.label: Touches by zone, {{home}} attacking left to right and {{away}} right to left.
territory.table: Touches by zone, as a table
territory.caption: Touches by zone

replay.title: Goals, replayed
replay.intro: The scoring team’s own actions before each goal, as the ball’s route: back to when the other team last had the ball, at most ten actions or forty seconds.
replay.label: Build-up of {{steps}} actions: {{chain}}
replay.play: Play the build-up to the {{minute}}' goal
replay.pause: Pause the build-up to the {{minute}}' goal
replay.again: Replay the build-up to the {{minute}}' goal
replay.noChain: No build-up recorded before this goal.
